name: manual_3c8025
claim: When Seth, the GrokBot chief of staff, spawns multiple cloud Cursor agent instances, each instance that writes files uses its own git worktree. A local worker agent liaises between those cloud instances and the MacBook Pro Orchestrator, and the Orchestrator canonical checkout stays put. One agent verifying a claimed commit reads that commit from the canonical checkout and does not create a worktree. Before attributing a failure to the lane under review, judge local-branch divergence with scripts/git/reanchor_scan.sh against origin/main.

decisions.notes: CodeRabbit review 5325082254 comment 4110603549 on Perpetua-Tools PR 400 treated lesson_25db2fe45992 as a universal detached-worktree step. The operating case is parallel cloud Cursor agents spawned by Seth, the GrokBot chief of staff, liaising with the MacBook Pro Orchestrator through a local worker agent. A single verifier stays on the canonical checkout. Divergence uses scripts/git/reanchor_scan.sh, not an ahead/behind count.
